conditions.headline: Bump of modest mid period SSW swell with some longer stuff mixing in. Outside corners benefit most.
conditions.observation: Could be just enough energy on the south swell magnets to see some improvement in size today. A small pulse of mid period SSW swell with a hint of some longer stuff in the mix too. This might be enough to nudge the outside reefs into the 1-2ft OH mark especially in the morning. Surf the incoming tide, make the most of lighter offshore/variable wind in AM

conditions.headline: Make the most of size and energy in AM, PM becoming more mellow
conditions.observation: Another modest pulse on the cards, just enough to keep swell magnets going. These spots could hover around 1ft OH, a little slower and smaller through the high tide mark. Quality not super high in these exposed zones as light southerly wind trends nearly all day, dawn session probably best but overall some lumpier conditions - maybe just enough to warrant a grovel .

conditions.headline: Small to mid sized options in the morning, get in before the high tide
conditions.observation: Size backs down, with some ok options early but the dropping swell will be easily swallowed up by the rush towards a 2.3m tide. Morning wind also best, light offshore for Bukit reefs and also a chance for the dawnie on the east side. Shoulder maybe bigger on the outer reefs, much smaller everywhere else.
